correctness.rationale: For a nonidentity cyclic relabeling of odd order ell>=3, an edge orbit meeting two distinct vertex orbits is a matching of ell edges (cover number ell), while an edge orbit internal to one vertex orbit is disjoint odd cycles (cover number at least ceil(ell/2)). Hence all nontrivial ell>=5 have no fixed nonempty faces and reduced Lefschetz trace −1. For ell=3, exactly m/3 disjoint triangle-orbit 2-simplices are fixed (each even vertex permutation), giving reduced Lefschetz m/3−1. The known homology concentration in degrees 3,4, H3 rank C(m−1,4), and known H4 4-subset permutation character (trace zero for odd nontrivial rotations) yield H3 traces 1 or 1−m/3. Cyclic Fourier inversion yields the claimed integer multiplicities; quotient invariant follows rational transfer after barycentric subdivision. Independently checked fixed-face cover obstructions for 42 powers at m=5,7,9,11,15 and the exact integer spectrum examples m9 and m15. C validity depends explicitly on published homology and top-degree character results, not on a finite verifier alone.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks corroborate exact identities only; all-parameter assertions depend on the reconstructed proof and named published premises.
